latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release – integrates baiz.ai’s Facebook ad management API.

- Enables creation and management of Facebook ad campaigns, ad sets, and ads via baiz.ai MCP API.
- Supports querying account balance, managing offers, audience targeting, copywriting, assets, and budgets.
- Provides example JSON-RPC calls and security guidance.
- Requires a BAIZ_API_TOKEN, generated from baiz.ai, for all operations.
- Includes detailed instructions for setup, safe token management, and operational best practices.
